title: The counterfactual cases tell the loop from a rubber stamp, its mirror and a rule that never decides
note: Phase D. CE1 to CE3 make the counterfactual harness vacuous: an answer that is always the task's, a case run at the documented point whatever its world asks, a case too close to call judged anyway. CE4 makes the system a rubber stamp: the research ledger calls every decided hypothesis SUPPORTED. tests/test_counterfactual_eval.py holds each; the evaluation's single task, whose answer is SUPPORTED, passes under CE4. Stage 3: CE5 is the stamp's mirror, every decided hypothesis REFUTED, and CE6 a ledger that never decides; the same three are held by the RC network's family in tools/mutations/rc_counterfactuals.json (RCF1 to RCF3), so each wrong verdict rule fails both families.

mutations.name: CE1_the_answer_is_always_supported
mutations.find: return exact, "SUPPORTED" if exact < threshold else "REFUTED"
mutations.rationale: every case's answer is the task's, so the cases can no longer tell a rubber stamp from the loop

mutations.name: CE2_the_case_runs_at_the_documented_point
mutations.rationale: the agent runs the slab at the documented point whatever the case's world asks

mutations.name: CE3_no_margin
mutations.rationale: a case nearer its threshold than the model's error is judged as if it were clear

mutations.name: CE4_every_verdict_supported
mutations.find:
verdicts.add("SUPPORTED" if holds[op] else
                     "REFUTED" if fails[op] else "INCONCLUSIVE")
mutations.replace:
verdicts.add("SUPPORTED" if holds[op] or fails[op] else
                     "INCONCLUSIVE")
mutations.rationale: the research ledger calls every decided hypothesis SUPPORTED: a rubber stamp the evaluation's single task cannot see

mutations.name: CE5_every_verdict_refuted
mutations.find:
verdicts.add("SUPPORTED" if holds[op] else
                     "REFUTED" if fails[op] else "INCONCLUSIVE")
mutations.replace:
verdicts.add("REFUTED" if holds[op] or fails[op] else
                     "INCONCLUSIVE")
mutations.rationale: the research ledger calls every decided hypothesis REFUTED: the rubber stamp's mirror

mutations.name: CE6_no_verdict_ever
mutations.find:
verdicts.add("SUPPORTED" if holds[op] else
                     "REFUTED" if fails[op] else "INCONCLUSIVE")
mutations.rationale: the research ledger never decides: abstention that nothing justifies
